verdict.rationale: Persona's own docs cover recognizing a returning person: Accounts group all of an individual's history, and reusing the same reference ID links multiple inquiries to one account. Connect lets organizations share KYC/KYB data through Share Tokens, which supports cross-product reuse of a prior check. Missing for 10: a documented re-verification flow (e.g., a lightweight selfie check against a prior passed check), explicit evidence that reuse skips a full re-run, details on Share Token consumption, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run

citations.quote: To link multiple inquiries to the same account, use the same reference ID for each inquiry.
A Persona account groups together all information you've collected from an individual user (a single person or business), and lets you view their entire history on Persona in one place.
Connect lets Persona organizations securely share KYC/KYB data with one another through Share Tokens.
